account_id.description: The account the cost posts to: an active account that is not a group, share capital, a money account, a director's account or GST control.

claim_gst.description: Claim the GST shown as input tax: only while the organisation is GST-registered on the posting date. A claim from before registration is made in the first GST return with IRAS's approval [verify]; otherwise the GST stays in the cost.

treatment.description: The income-tax treatment: deductible (a revenue cost from up to 12 months before the deemed start of business, Income Tax Act s14R), capital (such as incorporation costs or equipment), or not_deductible.
